changelog: - **A Pool is one colour in Live and Distribution, and a run strip puts a step where the rate strip does.** The Distribution chart coloured a Pool by its place among the Pools a Monte Carlo run tracked and ignored a colour you set, so a Pool could read one colour in Live and another in Distribution; it now draws each Pool in its Live colour. On the Timeline's strips, a run rule's strip drew each step one step later than the timetable strips on the same axis, and pointing at it could read the step before; both now put step k between steps k − 1 and k, and pointing reads the same step on both.
